abstract: Best practices for @hellajs/ssr, the pure HellaNode-to-HTML stringifier: picking ssr/ssr.async/ssr.stream by the tree's Promise shape, hydration markers, doc document assembly (mount selector, head, JSON data payload), CSS delivery through cssText and the hella-css id, head hoisting with ssr.head(), islands pairing with dom hydrate, and server semantics (resource fetch no-op, read-once props). Every rule is grounded in the package source and test suite.
